title: Spacecraft momentum anomalies in the Van Allen belts

tellings.quote:
like momentum anomalies for spacecraft
when they go around the earth
>> and they get to the Van Allen belts.
They either speed up or they slow down

plain: Spacecraft orbiting the Earth either speed up or slow down for no clear reason when they reach the Van Allen belts, zones of charged particles trapped around the planet. Charles Buhler, an engineer who has worked at NASA, the US space agency, mentions these momentum oddities without naming a source, as a sign that space may hold forces we do not yet understand.
